title: Full Turtle Armor Set
description: A mod that adds full turtle armor in a vanilla way. Armor trim support has not yet been added, it will be though.
body:
A mod that aims to add the rest of turtle armor in a vanilla way.

Helmet = 2 armor points and 10 seconds of water breathing
Chestplate = 7 armor points and 1 toughness, and 20 seconds of water breathing(stacks with helmet)
Leggings = 6 armor and infinite speed 1 in water
Boots = 2 armor and infinite speed 1 in water

If you wear leggings and boots you get infinite speed 2 in water(leggings texture is now 3d)

The textures are all made by me and based on the minecraft turtle.

Armor trim support will be added eventually.

Recipes are same as other armor except for the chestplate which requires 9 turtle scute.
Also, not reccomended to wear a cape when you have the chestplate on because the cape ruins the 3d texture.
